report.explanation: Current evidence contradicts the operator hypothesis: gateway checkout spans are OK, gateway and order logs show 200/ok, and order metrics show low error rate, no dependency timeouts, and no pool waiters. The deployment record only proves version facts (3.2.7 to 3.2.8, 1586 minutes old, valid config) and cannot establish deployment-caused latency or failure. No bounded root cause is supported, so hand off for human review with the missing evidence listed.
missing_evidence: No telemetry shows checkout failures: gateway traces/logs and order logs report OK/200 with error_rate 0.0014 and p95 73ms.
No evidence links order deployment 3.2.8 (1586 min old, config valid) to any failure; deployment record alone cannot establish causation.
Need failing checkout spans/errors and error-rate time series aligned to the alert window to bound any candidate cause.
